name: Étienne de Callataÿ
detail: Advocates real estate property tax reform, capital gains tax, and tax simplification, but explicitly opposes standalone net wealth taxation and warns against capital flight.

name: Vincent Van Peteghem
detail: As Minister of Finance proposed broad tax reform including dual income tax and reform of the securities account tax, but opposed general net wealth taxation.

name: Georges-Louis Bouchez
detail: Leader of MR (Mouvement Réformateur); vigorously opposes any wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune / miljonairstaks), calling it punitive and economically damaging.

name: Bart De Wever
detail: Leader of N-VA; vehemently opposes net wealth taxation or a millionaires' tax, calling it 'volksbedrog' and arguing it drives capital flight and harms Flemish families and entrepreneurs.

name: CD&V
detail: Flemish Christian-democrats; favour capital income taxation (vermogenswinstbelasting) and dual income tax, but explicitly oppose standalone net wealth taxation (vermogensbelasting).

name: Benoît Piedboeuf
detail: Leader of MR parliamentary group in the Chamber; vigorously opposes wealth taxation or taxes on large fortunes, arguing it penalises work and entrepreneurship.

name: Peter De Roover
detail: N-VA parliamentary leader; vehemently opposes net wealth taxation, warning against excessive tax burdens and capital flight.

name: Ben Weyts
detail: Flemish Vice Minister-President (N-VA); explicitly opposes a wealth register and wealth tax: 'Wat willen we in de hele discussie en wat willen we zeker niet? We willen geen vermogenskadaster.'

name: Egbert Lachaert
detail: Former Open Vld party leader and Flemish MP; opposed wealth taxation and wealth register in plenary debate on 25 June 2025: 'Mocht het nu alleen over de allerrijksten gaan, dan zou ik minder bezorgd zijn.'

name: Benoît Piedboeuf
detail: MR Federal Group Leader; mocks wealth taxation and wealth register: 'Et si quelqu’un trouve dans son grenier une peinture d’une grande valeur ? Va-t-on organiser des perquisitions pour vérifier ?'

name: Peter De Roover
detail: N-VA Chamber President and former Group Leader; opposes wealth taxation: 'fiscale hervormingen de bereidheid van de hogere middenklasse om belastingen te betalen niet mogen hypothekeren.'

name: Open Vld
detail: Flemish liberal party officially opposes a wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune / vermogensbelasting) and wealth cadastre.

name: Les Engagés
detail: Centrist francophone party officially opposes a net wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune).

name: DéFI
detail: Francophone democratic party officially opposes a net wealth tax (impôt sur la fortune).

name: Marc Goblet
detail: Former Federal MP (PS) and former General Secretary of FGTB; cosponsored DOC 55 0036/001 in 2019; passed away in 2021.
